title: The Blockchain Imitation Game (Ape)
authors: Kaihua Qin, Stefanos Chaliasos, Liyi Zhou, Benjamin Livshits, Dawn Song, Arthur Gervais
named_incidents: Popsicle Finance attack (Ape would earn 20.25M USD): 0xcd7dae143a4c0223349c16237ce4cd7696b1638d116a72755231ede872ab70fc; Auctus ACOWriter 0x2e7d7e7a6eb157b98974c8687fbd848d0158d37edc1302ea08ee5ddb376befea and BMIZapper 0xe12ae015c8023bbe6405662a3ddf5e8e106e7f6255e905b7312dcf65b27d755c (possible vulns). Window: ETH blocks 12936340-15253305, BSC blocks 9643812-20045094 (2021-08-01 to 2022-07-31).
notes: Ape found 17 blackhat and 12 self-proclaimed whitehat txs across 13 known DeFi attacks on Ethereum (73.74M USD); 10 of 12 whitehat txs appear to have been sent privately to miners. 22 attacks / 40 txs on BSC (22.39M USD). Simulation of imitation, not an observed-bot-copy list; per-incident table not extracted (only first 100k chars of ar5iv read).

title: BACKRUNNER: Mitigating Smart Contract Attacks in the Real World
authors: Chaofan Shou, Yuanyu Ke, Qi Su, Doudou Lu, Jacob Chia, Yupeng Yang, Wenke Lee, Or Dadosh, Assaf Eli, David Benchimol, Daniel Tong, Dex Chen, Zoey Tan, Koushik Sen
named_incidents: Table I lists 54 attacks (2023-01 to 2024-05, 158 attack txs, from Phalcon/BlockSec incident list) incl. Curve 2023-07-30, TransitFi 2023-12-19, BarleyFi 2024-01-28, Hope.money 2023-10-18, SafeMoon 2023-03-28, EarningFarm, Sushiswap, HundredFi, EulerFi, WiseLending, Dexible, Kyberswap, Radiant, Seneca, Bot 0x8c2d, Bot 0x05f0 etc. No tx hashes extracted.
notes: Only 18 of 158 attack txs were intercepted by attack-frontrunning bots (<$31.5M rescued, 8.7% of loss); only 17/158 visible in public mempool pre-inclusion. Authors ran their own frontrunning bot 6+ months; BSC honeypot Sept 2023 ($3K) drew 6+ bots, 189 bids from 10 to 60,000 gwei. Says BlockSec runs an attack-frontrunning bot (>$15M rescued since 2022). Says data is public but no URL seen in first 100k chars; check paper tail/GitHub for per-tx list of the 18 intercepted txs.
